items.title: Melba Liston — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: names other bandmembers: John Collins, Jimmie Heath, Specs Wright, Al McKibbon, Willie Cook, John Lewis.

ctx.x: [names other bandmembers: John Collins, Jimmie Heath, Specs Wright, Al McKibbon, Willie Cook, John Lewis. She asks about the bop style and about the other trombone players in the band.]
[recalls that one of the bandmembers told her some things about the bop style, but she cannot recall details. She does not remember the other trombonists.]
